name: Hit sparks
blurb: Thin streaks thrown out from a hit, stretched along their path.

name: Slash streaks
blurb: Fast long streaks that fly one way, like a sword hit.

name: Skid sparks
blurb: Streaks that shoot out and fall, like metal scraping.

name: Fire sparks
blurb: Round sparks that scatter and drift down slowly.

name: Rising flames
blurb: A burst of flame that climbs and fades.

name: Burning aura
blurb: Keeps emitting small flames that rise off the bone.

name: Floating embers
blurb: Keeps emitting a few slow embers that drift and fade.

name: Fire trail
blurb: Leaves flames behind a moving bone (Roy's sword).

name: Smoke puff
blurb: A puff that bursts out, grows and fades.

name: Dash dust
blurb: Dust kicked one way along the ground.

name: Steam
blurb: Keeps emitting soft smoke that rises.

name: Debris
blurb: Chunks thrown up that fall back down.

name: Leaves
blurb: Many light pieces that scatter and float down.

name: Impact flash
blurb: One bright pop for three frames.

name: Lightning crackle
blurb: A short stretched bolt that snaps out and vanishes.

name: Ring
blurb: One ring that appears in place and expands as it fades.
